name: eyebite
lore:
### The Malefic Gaze: A Treatise on *Eyebite*

To cast *Eyebite* is to invite a freezing needle into the mind’s eye. As you weave the incantation, the Weave feels oily and heavy, pressing against your brow like leaden coins. When the spell takes hold, your irises dissolve into ink-black voids, leaking a faint, violet miasma that smells of ozone and old graves.

The manifestation is visceral: your vision becomes a conduit for pure, concentrated dread. To look upon a foe is to lash them with your very will, forcing their heart to stutter in terror or their limbs to succumb to a magical lethargy.

**The Legend of its Genesis**
Chronicles attribute this hex to **Malakor the Sightless**, a warlock-prince who traded his eyes to a Great Old One for forbidden truths. Legend claims that upon returning to the mortal plane, Malakor found he no longer needed pupils to perceive his enemies. He simply projected the hollow agony of his empty sockets onto the living. He did not need to see his rivals to break them; he only needed them to look back. 

*Scholar’s Note: Do not blink while the void is open, lest the darkness settle within your own soul.*
